SSC Delhi Police Constable (Executive) PE & MT Notice 2026

Post Date: July 30, 2026

4:50 pm

Staff Selection Commission (SSC Delhi Police), has released the PHYSICAL ENDURANCE AND MEASUREMENT TEST (PE&MT) on its official website for the Recruitment of Delhi Police Constable Examination 2025. The PE & MT Exam will be conducted on 19 August – 01 September 2026, The SSC application process started on 22 September 2025, and candidates were able to submit their applications until 31 October 2025. Candidates can check their PE & MT Notice using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct link is provided below.
